target_moa.text: Bremelanotide is a synthetic heptapeptide melanocortin receptor (MCR) agonist; a nonselective high-affinity agonist for melanocortin receptors, with MC4R (expressed on CNS neurons) mediating relevant sexual-function activity.

citations.quote: Vyleesi is a drug-device combination product containing the active ingredient bremelanotide (BMT), a synthetic heptapeptide and melanocortin receptor (MCR) agonist, in a prefilled syringe.

BMT is a nonselective, high-affinity ligand and agonist for MCRs, of which there are five subtypes. For the purposes of this application, the pharmacologically relevant receptors are MC4R, MC3R, and MC1R.
Vyleesi is a drug-device combination product containing the active ingredient bremelanotide (BMT), a synthetic heptapeptide and melanocortin receptor (MCR) agonist, in a prefilled syringe.

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (>4%): nausea (40.0% vs 1.3% placebo), flushing (20.3% vs 0.3%), injection site reactions (13.2% vs 8.4%), headache (11.3% vs 1.9%), and vomiting (4.8% vs 0.2%). Discontinuation due to adverse reactions was 18% (BMT) vs 2% (placebo). Warnings include transient blood pressure increase/heart rate reduction and focal hyperpigmentation.
